scene_objective: Ben bypasses the Jedi partner roster and calls Desh Rolan. The choice looks pragmatic and is; it is also the third solo move of the evening.
opening_mode: Ben sits in his ship's cockpit with the preflight complete and his thumb sliding past the Jedi partner roster to open his personal contacts instead

key_beats.beat_description: Ben bypasses three Jedi Knight contacts on his datapad and opens his personal list
Desh's voice crackles over long-range comm — dry greeting, no questions asked
Ben's ship lifts from the Temple hangar bay and angles toward orbit
The ship punches into hyperspace; Ben's instruments flicker as the wrongness persists through the jump

turning_point.trigger: Desh answers the comm with dry humor and agrees to the job without asking why Ben did not call a Jedi. They both know why, and neither says so.
turning_point.shift: Desh answers the comm with dry humor and agrees to the job without asking why Ben did not call a Jedi. They both know why, and neither says so.

closing_beat: The wrongness in the Force shifts as Ben leaves Coruscant — not diminishing but acquiring direction, like a compass needle settling

emotional_arc.shift: Calculated avoidance -> familiar comfort with Desh -> unsettled recognition that the wrongness is guiding him
